edges.semantics: Ecology refines its parent domain (101 front matter: parent: SCR-LIB-DATA); ecological state is structured meaningful information

Ecology contains the Flora subdomain; flora population membership is an explicit instance list (ECOLOGY-INV-003)
Ecology provides the environment in which evolution may occur and describes co-evolutionary dynamics, while remaining distinct from evolution (101 sections 12-13; ECOLOGY-INV-013)
